searchText: MSRP $145,446. The new 2026 Thor Motor Coach Four Winds Class C RV 25Z is approximately 26 feet 5 inches in length featuring the new Ford chassis. The Four Winds RV has an incredible list of standard features including twin bed king conversion, power windows and locks, power patio awning with integrated LED lighting, in-dash media center AM/FM & Bluetooth, power vent in bath, skylight above shower, cab A/C and so much more. Optional features include the 50 state California compliant Gas/LP generator.
